claudinestore.desc: Human resources management application for Claudine Store. It allows for employee tracking, payroll management, and automatic payslip generation, offering a reliable, fast, and secure solution to simplify administrative management. Also included is the creation of an e-commerce platform for selling computer and electronic equipment, developed with Laravel for the back-end user interface and Tailwind CSS and Chart.js for a modern, responsive, and high-performance design.

scholarchart.desc: Administrative management application designed for employee data entry and tracking, payroll management, and automatic payslip generation. It offers a reliable, fast, and secure solution to simplify human resources management.

boristech.desc:
Boris Tech is an e-commerce platform dedicated to the sale of computer hardware and electronic equipment.
It was designed with Laravel for the backend, Vue.js for the user interface and Tailwind CSS for a modern, responsive and performant design.
